text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read
      discussions: read
    steps:
      - name: Claude Code Action
        uses: claude-ai/claude-code@v1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          claude_api_key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
```
